Get info on utility norms

Source: R/get_info.R
get_norm_info.Rd

Get info on utility norms

Usage

get_norm_info(country = NULL, references = F)

Arguments

country

string - name of a permissible country

references

boolean - set to T if you wish to return reference information (DOI, URL)

Value

A dataframe containing information about utility norms

Examples

get_norm_info()
